Health Policy & Literacy Advocates

Educating the next generation of healthcare advocates at Emory University.

Join our GroupMe Follow @emory.hpla on Instagram
Why we exist

HPLA exists because Emory has a large pre-health community that is passionate about helping people but often enters medicine without understanding the systemic forces shaping American healthcare: the policies, inequities, and structural barriers that define patient outcomes.

Our goal is to change that. We create a space where future physicians and public health professionals can become informed advocates before they ever enter a clinical setting.

What we do

How members take part

No background in policy is needed. Most members start by joining a weekly meeting.

Every week

Campus education

Weekly member-led presentations on health policy and literacy topics. Members research and present in small groups, turning every meeting into a learning session.

Around Atlanta

Community outreach

We partner with underserved Atlanta communities to deliver health literacy presentations, helping residents understand their rights and navigate the healthcare system.

Through the year

Events and advocacy

From expert panels with Emory SoM and Rollins School of Public Health students, to 5K runs, letter-writing campaigns, and campus poster initiatives.
